how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.ar: في أربع أشكال من المساطر، والسؤال هو اللي بيختار بينهم مش الموضة.
sentences.en: There are four shapes of ruler and the question chooses between them, not fashion.

sentences.ar: النموذج الخطي بيرسم حد مستقيم وسهل تشرحه.
sentences.en: A linear model draws a straight boundary and is easy to explain.

sentences.ar: والشجرة بتقسّم على عتبات وبتتعامل مع التفاعلات بشكل طبيعي بس غير مستقرة لوحدها.
sentences.en: A tree splits on thresholds and handles interactions naturally but is unstable on its own.

sentences.ar: والـensembles بتاخد متوسط شجر كتير وغالباً أقوى حاجة هتـfit على داتا جدولية.
sentences.en: Ensembles average many trees and are usually the strongest thing you will fit on tabular data.

sentences.ar: والطرق المبنية على المسافة بتفترض إن القرب معناه التشابه، وده تمام لحد ما يبقى عندك أعمدة كتير.
sentences.en: Distance-based methods assume nearness means similarity, which is fine until you have many columns.

sentences.ar: اختار قبل ما تـfit، باستخدام عدد الصفوف لكل parameter: نموذج مرن على داتا صغيّرة هيتعلم الضوضاء وهو واثق جداً.
sentences.en: Pick before you fit, using rows per parameter: a flexible model on a small dataset will learn noise with great confidence.

sentences.ar: بعدها التقييم، والفخ اللي كل حد بيقابله مرة.
sentences.en: Then evaluation, and the trap everyone meets once.

sentences.ar: الـclassifier ده دقته تسعة وتسعين في الميّة والـconfusion matrix بتوري إنه ما مسكش ولا حالة من اللي اتعمل عشانها،
sentences.en: This classifier is ninety-nine percent accurate — and the confusion matrix shows it caught none of the cases you built it for,

sentences.ar: لأن واحد في الميّة بس من الداتا إيجابي، وإنك تقول لأ كل مرة بيدّيك تسعة وتسعين.
sentences.en: because only one percent of the data is positive and predicting no every time scores ninety-nine.

sentences.ar: فاستخدم الـprecision لما الإنذار الكاذب غالي، والـrecall لما الفوات غالي، والـF1 لما تحتاج رقم واحد.
sentences.en: So use precision when a false alarm is expensive, recall when a miss is expensive, and F1 when you need one number.

sentences.ar: والعتبة مش اختيار إحصائي، دي اختيار بيزنس: حرّكها وبصّ على التكلفة بالفلوس وهي بتتبدل بين الإيجابيات الكاذبة والسلبيات الكاذبة.
sentences.en: The threshold is not a statistical choice, it is a business one: move it and watch the cost in pounds swap between false positives and false negatives.

sentences.ar: والـcross-validation بتدّيك تقدير أثبت لأنها بتلفّ على الـfold المحجوزة ولازم تحافظ على المجموعات كاملة، وإلا تكون أعدت بناء الـleak بتاع الشابتر اللي فات جوه التقييم نفسه.
sentences.en: Cross-validation gives you a more stable estimate by rotating the held-out fold — and it must keep groups intact, or you have rebuilt the leak from the last chapter inside your evaluation.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً الـbias والـvariance. زوّد درجة كثير الحدود: خطأ التدريب بيفضل ينزل وخطأ الاختبار بيرجع يطلع.
sentences.en: Finally, bias and variance. Increase the polynomial degree: training error keeps falling while test error turns back upward.

sentences.ar: ونقطة الرجوع دي هي الـoverfitting، بالشوف مش بالتعريف.
sentences.en: That turning point is overfitting, visible rather than defined.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: - A classifier that always predicts no on a problem with 1 % positives scores 99 % accuracy and catches zero cases (CH-30).
- A classifier that always predicts no on a problem with 1 % positives scores 99 % accuracy and catches zero cases (CH-30).

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A hierarchical structure of nodes with one root and child branches, no cycles; used for indexes, search and decision models.
concepts.def_ar: الـtree هيكل هرمي من nodes له root واحد وفروع، من غير cycles؛ بيتستخدم في الـindexes والبحث والـdecision models.
concepts.failure: Letting a tree become unbalanced, so lookups degrade toward a linear walk.

concepts.def_en: A named input in a function's definition; the caller supplies a value, called the argumen…
concepts.failure: Typing values by hand inside the code instead of passing them as parameters.

concepts.def_en: A table of predicted versus actual classes, counting true and false positives and negatives; it shows what accuracy hides.
concepts.def_ar: الـconfusion matrix جدول بيقارن المتوقع بالفعلي، وبيعدّ الـtrue والـfalse positives والـnegatives، وبيكشف اللي الـaccuracy بتداريه.
concepts.failure: Trusting high accuracy on imbalanced data when the matrix shows no real cases caught.

concepts.def_en: The score cut-off above which a model says yes; moving it trades false positives against false negatives, so it is a business choice.
concepts.def_ar: الـthreshold الحد اللي فوقه الـmodel بيقول آه؛ تحريكه بيبدّل بين الـfalse positives والـfalse negatives، فهو قرار business.
concepts.failure: Leaving the default cut-off untouched without pricing the cost of each error type.

concepts.def_en: Evaluating a model by rotating which fold is held out for testing, averaging the scores; group-aware folds keep related rows together.
concepts.def_ar: الـcross validation تقييم الـmodel بإنك تبدّل الـfold المحجوز للاختبار وتاخد متوسط النتايج؛ والـgroup version بيسيب الصفوف المرتبطة مع بعض.
concepts.failure: Naive folds on grouped data split one group across train and test, leaking.

concepts.def_en: A model memorises noise in the training data instead of the real pattern, so it scores well on training but poorly on new data.
concepts.def_ar: الـoverfitting لما الموديل يحفظ الضوضاء في داتا الـtraining بدل النمط الحقيقي، فيبقى ممتاز على الـtraining وضعيف على داتا جديدة.
concepts.failure: Judging the model only by its training score, never checking held-out data.
